evidence.quote: Color is not used as the only visual means of conveying information, indicating an action,
If any audio on a web page plays automatically for more than 3 seconds,

Scope note: WCAG is cited as a guideline only. The brief names no accessibility standard and no legal duty is claimed for this class project. Fetched via a summarising tool that caps quotes at 125 chars, so quotes are fragments of the normative sentences.

outcomes.note: WCAG 1.4.1 says colour must not be the only means of conveying information; 1.4.2 covers auto-playing audio. Applies by analogy to position/hazards signalled by colour or audio alone; WCAG does not specifically govern browser games.
outcomes.would_settle: Owner decides whether any accessibility standard applies; if WCAG AA is adopted, 1.4.1 covers hazard/position cues.

evidence.quote: All functionality of the content is operable through a keyboard interface
The remapping of keys used to control movement or interaction in virtual environments is not currently required by WCAG.

Scope note: WCAG is cited as a guideline only. The brief names no accessibility standard and no legal duty is claimed for this class project. Fetched via a summarising tool that caps quotes at 125 chars, so quotes are fragments of the normative sentences.

outcomes.note: WCAG 2.1.1 requires keyboard operability, but its path-dependent-movement exception may cover steering, so applicability to a racing game is unclear. W3C XAUR says WCAG does not require key remapping and points to external game-specific guidelines (not fetched).
outcomes.would_settle: Owner lists supported input methods (keyboard/touch/gamepad) in the brief.

evidence.quote: The buffer contains the audio signal waveform encoded as a series of amplitudes in the following format: non-interleaved IEEE754 32-bit linear PCM
Objects of these types are designed to hold small audio snippets, typically less than 45 s.
The single argument to this callback is an AudioBuffer representing the decodedData (the decoded PCM audio data).
represents a memory-resident audio asset.
usually somewhat less than a minute.
3 min stereo 44.1 kHz = 31.8 MB as 16-bit PCM, 63.5 MB as 32-bit float; 5 tracks about 318 MB (supplied by orchestrator, not recomputed here; spec format is 32-bit float so 63.5 MB each applies)

outcomes.note: Spec and MDN say decoded audio is memory-resident float PCM meant for short clips, so decoding multi-minute tracks is off-design. No browser memory limit is documented in MDN decodeAudioData or the W3C spec text read.
